description:
🌍 Douala Earth Watchers: a team from Douala using NASA satellite data to track rainfall 🌧️, temperature 🌡️ and vegetation 🌱 around the city.
🚀 Project: an interactive dashboard to spot areas at risk of flooding and extreme heat.
👨‍🎓 Student passionate about tech and data. Beginners welcome! 🤝
🔎 We're looking for: 📊 data, 💻 web dev, 🎨 design, 🎤 public speaking.
✨ Join us! 🇨🇲
